provenance.description: Authored templates, algorithmically generated checksums and documented example domains; phone plausibility checked with phonenumbers 9.0.41. No production data or assignment guarantee.

limitations: Independent human gold review pending; generated checks are not review.
Development corpus, not held-out and not representative of deployment prevalence.
Families conservatively group correlated values, formatting, mutations and reused mixture controls; family counts are not independent sample sizes.
Gold phone checks use phonenumbers 9.0.41, also pinned by Presidio; Horizon pins libphonenumber-js 1.13.16 with separately versioned metadata. Cross-runtime metadata equivalence is not asserted.
No identity, ownership, card issuer, bank account assignment or domestic CIN verification.
Omocodia is out of scope; contextual PERSON and email interpretation require review.

policy.PERSON: Full given name and surname, isolated or contextual; single given name or surname requires clear personal context. Bare ambiguous words, organizations and places are negative.
policy.EMAIL_ADDRESS: Syntactically valid email addresses, including generic/business mailboxes and single-label domains; no DNS or delivery check. Annotate overlaps even inside excluded-category distractors.
policy.PHONE_NUMBER: Any country with explicit + or 00 prefix; national numbers default to IT; metadata-valid whole envelope only, no valid substring salvaged from malformed, long or Unicode-adjacent envelopes.
policy.IT_FISCAL_CODE: Canonical 16-character Italian fiscal code with checksum and whole-token boundaries; lowercase accepted; omocodia out of scope, not asserted administratively invalid.
policy.IT_VAT_CODE: 11 digits with checksum, compact optional IT prefix; all-zero is negative; whole-token boundaries.
policy.IBAN_CODE: Italian 27-character IBAN, mod97 valid; ASCII spaces allowed; whole-token boundaries; domestic CIN and assignment not verified.
policy.CREDIT_CARD: 13–19 ASCII digits passing Luhn, ASCII spaces/hyphens allowed; whole envelope; no issuer or assignment claim.
